resources.string: Start Oculibre on the computer, then press Start.
Plug the phone into the computer
Turn the screen off while live
Saves battery and heat: lowest brightness, then the screen goes off as usual.
The camera and the quality are chosen from the computer.
Battery saving may cut the webcam
With the screen off, Android can stop Oculibre.
No quality supported by this phone was found
Camera access refused: Oculibre cannot film.
Oculibre films with the phone\'s camera. The picture only goes to your computer, never to the Internet.
Without it, Oculibre cannot film at all. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere else than to your own computer.
Without the camera, Oculibre cannot work. You can allow it later in Android\'s settings.
While the phone films, a notification says so: you see at a glance that the camera is on, and you can stop it from there.
Stay active with the screen off
So that the webcam doesn\'t stop in the middle of a call or a stream when the screen turns off.

Over Wi-Fi: open Oculibre on the computer, click \"Add a phone\", then scan the QR code it shows. Over the USB cable: turn on USB debugging (Settings › Developer options), plug the phone in and allow the computer. USB debugging gives the computer wide access to the phone: only allow your own computer, never a public one, and turn it off when you do not use it. This is temporary: a future version will connect over USB without it.
Next time, just open Oculibre and press Start.
You see when the camera films.

The webcam won\'t be cut in the middle of a call.

Scan the QR code shown by the computer. Over USB, USB debugging is needed instead.
Over the USB cable, turn on USB debugging (Developer options) and allow the computer: only your own computer, never a public one.
